description: Renames a case file or changes its reference, description or status (OPEN or CLOSED). Every field is optional: send only what changes. A CLOSED case file refuses new evidence groups and evidences (evidence_group_create, evidence_create, evidence_upload) until it is set back to OPEN. Needs the editor role or higher on the case file; the user's personal case file cannot be updated (403). Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId. Returns no body; confirm with case_file_get.

status.description: OPEN or CLOSED. OPEN is the state every case file is created in; it accepts new evidence groups and evidences. CLOSED: creating evidence groups and evidences (evidence_group_create, evidence_create, evidence_upload) is refused while the case file stays closed.

name: case_file_update
